title: Security
subtitle: Manage your password and active sessions.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.desc: Pick a password you don't use anywhere else. After saving, all your other devices will be signed out (this device stays signed in).
changePassword.successBody: Other devices have been signed out. Your password is now active.
changePassword.mismatchMsg: The new password and confirmation do not match.
changePassword.wrongCurrentMsg: The current password you entered is incorrect.
changePassword.sameMsg: New password must be different from the current one.
changePassword.googleMsg: This account uses Google sign-in. Use "Forgot password" to set one.

logoutAll.title: Sign out of all devices
logoutAll.desc: Ends every active TradeHub session, including this one. Use this if you've signed in on a device you no longer have, or suspect your account has been accessed without your permission.
logoutAll.revokedBody_one: {{count}} session signed out. Redirecting you to sign in…
logoutAll.revokedBody_other: {{count}} sessions signed out. Redirecting you to sign in…
logoutAll.failMsg: Could not sign you out — please try again.
